bot.help.text:
📚 Claire Bible — personal knowledge base bot
  (repository: {repo})

Send an item and the bot ingests it:
  • Links (web/YouTube/x.com/google share)
  • PDF and text files
  • Free text such as keywords and notes
→ Scrape → Gemini structuring → storage as a graph, with automatic links to existing items.
  When related links are found, the 'Get' button expands by 1 hop.

💡 Multiple theme mode:
  • At ingest, interactive buttons ask for the target theme.
  • A message that contains `#1` or `#<theme name>` goes to that theme immediately.

💡 Share URL management (one-touch actions & flags):
  • Send the share URL (/p?s=...) or the document ID of a stored document to get
    the buttons for body regeneration and source refetch (length limit / full length).
  • With options, the operation starts immediately:
    Example: https://.../p?s=token --refetch-full --effort high

💡 Options:
  • No-truncation and effort options: https://example.com/doc --full --effort high
  • For a file or a PDF, write the options (--full, --effort high) in the caption
  • The ingest focus is off. Text after a separator (| or an empty line) is ignored.

Commands:
  /kb [number|name] — select the default search theme and show the theme list
  /search <keyword> — hybrid search + summary (with citations)
  /ingest <URL|text> — ingest an item
  /support bundle [days] [target] — create a diagnostic Support Bundle (default 1 day, automatic deletion after 6 hours)
  /web — issue a one-time web login link (login cookie for 7 days, ingest and edit permitted)
  /webro — issue a read-only web link (graph, search, and documents only, safe to share)
  /repo — source repository link
  /status — status (graph size, convergence, recent input)
  /failed — show failed and permanently failed items
  /retry <number> — retry one failed item
  /help — this help
  /start — start guide

console.support.pipeline.legend: Each ingest picks the API path or the agent client (MCP) path. “API ingest only” does not run in agent client ingest; “Conditional” runs only when settings or models differ; “Independent branch” does not feed resolution; “No AI” uses rules only.
console.support.pipeline.step.input.desc: Fetches text from web pages, files (PDF/ODT), notes, or videos. Videos try captions first and fall back to audio transcription (STT). Thin web pages with images escalate to VLM. Both STT and VLM run on API ingest only.
console.support.pipeline.step.check.desc: Checks content hash, canonical URL, and MinHash duplicates, then runs validate_extractable_content to block empty text, missing video transcripts, or low-quality web shells.
console.support.pipeline.step.effort.des: A PDF or ODT file: the classification model (effort {classifier}) checks if it is a paper. A paper of {threshold} characters or more gets the effort {paper}. Other documents use the effort of the model.
console.support.pipeline.step.extract.de: The extract_graph slot produces the summary, key claims, entities, and relations in one call.
console.support.pipeline.step.summary.de: Re-generates the summary via the summarize slot only when its provider, model, or effort differs from extract_graph. Otherwise keeps the summary from step 5.
console.support.pipeline.step.detail.des: The render_detail slot runs as an independent parallel branch writing readable AsciiDoc into documents.detail. It does not feed entity resolution and failures do not abort ingest.
console.support.pipeline.step.resolve.de: Each entity passes through the gates in order and stops at the first gate that decides.
console.support.pipeline.gate1: Gate 1 (exact / alias / acronym match): Merges immediately when normalized name, alias, or acronym matches and passes hard invariants. Uses zero embeddings and zero LLM calls.
console.support.pipeline.gate2: Gate 2 (candidate search + hard invariants): Only on Gate 1 miss, creates 1 embedding and searches vector + FTS candidates (plus Jev shadow in parallel when enabled), then rejects version conflicts, <=2-char uppercase acronyms, and incompatible types.
console.support.pipeline.gate3: Gate 3 (auto-merge): Automatically merges when vector similarity is {auto} or higher.
console.support.pipeline.gate4: Gate 4 (borderline + FTS LLM judge): Borderline candidates ({low}–{auto}) and FTS-only candidates are judged by entity_judge, up to {max} calls per entity.
console.support.pipeline.gate5: Gate 5 (create new): If no candidate merges, creates a new entity node and stores its vector.
console.support.pipeline.jev_side: Jev (shadow evaluation) receives a snapshot of name, type, aliases, and observations for Gate 1 misses and records scores only. It never changes a decision.
console.support.pipeline.step.record.des: Stores the per-entity resolution_log and a candidate heatmap matrix (up to 30 candidates) in document metadata.
Keeps intra-document relations whose two endpoints resolve to distinct entities and pass ontology domain/range validation.
console.support.pipeline.step.links.desc: The relation_judge slot evaluates Gate 7 relational_candidates pairs (up to {per_doc} per document) and adds verified cross-document edges.
console.support.pipeline.step.lineage.de: Records the actual provider, model, and effort used at each stage in documents.meta.model_lineage.

console.synd.webmcp.desc: With WebMCP (W3C Web Machine Learning CG, Draft Community Group Report 2026-10-27), a page registers tools with document.modelContext.registerTool(), and an agent of the browser or of an extension calls them in the tab that the user has open. It operates with the current session and no added token, is visible only to same-origin documents, and stops when the tab closes or the registration signal aborts. The repository has no code for it.
console.synd.webmcp.confirm_desc: The specification has no API with which a tool asks for user confirmation (an open issue in the README). Thus a tool that needs confirmation opens a confirmation dialog of the page in execute() and waits for the answer, and has consequentialHint to cause a confirmation on the agent side. Writes and external publication always ask for confirmation, independently of the policy.
console.synd.webmcp.mode_desc: The specification defines only the imperative registerTool(). The declarative method, which exposes the + Subscribe form as a tool with form attributes (toolname · tooldescription · toolautosubmit), is an explainer proposal and is only an experimental option here.
console.synd.webmcp.tools_desc: Only the tools of the open workspace tab are registered (example: client_* while the federation client tab is open). A tool that returns third-party content, such as federated posts or collected sources, has untrustedContentHint. In a private theme, tools with an effect on external servers are not registered.
console.synd.webmcp.enabled_desc: When this is off, /syndication registers no tools, and the server sends Permissions-Policy: tools=(), thus other scripts in the page cannot register tools. Claire does not send the Permissions-Policy header now.
console.synd.webmcp.activity_desc: Gets the toolactivated and toolcancel events, shows text such as Agent: kb_ingest_item in progress in the status bar at the bottom of the reader, and writes it to the activity record.
console.synd.webmcp.sim_desc: Shows the code that registers the selected tool in the format of the specification, and the sequence that the user sees when an agent calls it. The simulation does not change the real state.

console.support.pipeline.step.post.desc: On fresh primary ingest (non-partial), classify_watch uses the classify slot to mark changing documents for periodic refresh. When auto_expand is enabled, the document is queued for expand-loop; otherwise candidate links are proposed.
console.support.pipeline.client_flow.hin: Parallel MCP path where an external agent extracts with its own LLM and submits a validated batch via extract_submit.
console.support.pipeline.client_flow.ste: 1. stage_raw (raw staging): Fetches and deduplicates source text into pending state with server STT, VLM, and paper classify disabled.
2. extract_claim / extract_read: The MCP agent acquires an exclusive lease (claim_token) and reads nonce-bounded source chunks (<untrusted_source_document>).
3. Agent LLM batch extraction: The client LLM produces summary, AsciiDoc detail, key claims, entities, and relations in one structured payload.

4. extract_submit 4-layer validation + embedding precomputation: Server validates schema, AsciiDoc rules, evidence spans, and ontology constraints, then precomputes all entity vectors (including dual-embed targets) with embed_model before writing.

5. Rule + vector resolution & atomic commit: Resolves entities via Gate 1 + vector similarity in one atomic transaction (extraction_origin: agent_client). Skips Gate 4 LLM judge, Jev shadow, heatmap matrix, cross-document relation_judge, and classify_watch.

pipeline.neon.gate.5: Gate 5 · New entity & relation candidate collection
pipeline.neon.gate_desc.1: Gate 1 passed: normalized name, alias, or acronym match merges immediately without embedding or LLM judging.
pipeline.neon.gate_desc.2: Gate 2 blocked: version number conflict (e.g. v1 vs v2) excludes candidate and splits into a new entity.
pipeline.neon.gate_desc.3: Gate 3 passed ({score} >= {auto}): auto-merged via high-confidence 3072d cosine similarity.
pipeline.neon.gate_desc.4_client: Borderline score ({score}), but Gate 4 LLM judging is skipped in agent client mode, so Gate 5 creates a new entity (+ relation candidate).
pipeline.neon.gate_desc.4_api: Gate 4 triggered ({border} <= {score} < {auto}): entity_judge (up to 3 candidates) decides SAME vs DIFFERENT.
pipeline.neon.gate_desc.5_rel: Gate 5 new entity ({score} >= 0.70): stored as new entity and relation candidate
pipeline.neon.gate_desc.5_new: Gate 5 new entity ({score} < 0.70): stored as new entity

pipeline.neon.spec5.title: Canonical Commit · Knowledge Constellation · Follow-ups
pipeline.neon.beat1.title: 01. Collect · Preprocess · Seal Source (A1)
pipeline.neon.beat1.input: URL, PDF/ODT/DOCX/TXT, free notes, attachment + link composite input
pipeline.neon.beat1.api: Every entrypoint passes SSRF private-network blocking and extracts text via PDFium -> web adapters -> Scrapling -> CDP. Videos prefer creator captions -> auto captions -> STT (gemini-3.5-transcribe); PDF/ODT metadata is normalized by classify and sealed in immutable raw_text.
pipeline.neon.beat1.client: stage_raw(full_content=True) collects the full source text and SHA-256 hash with server STT, VLM, and paper classification disabled, isolating it in pending state (hidden from search/federation; agent_source_staged notification skipped).
pipeline.neon.beat1.fail: Private-network IPs, empty PDFs, failed preferred-caption downloads, or blocked pages under 300 chars record an error and stop collection.
pipeline.neon.beat1.acc_title: Details: Unified entrypoint guard · Video caption-to-STT priority
pipeline.neon.beat1.acc_1: One gate for all entrypoints: Web UI, REST API, CLI, Telegram bot (single or composite 2x budget), feeds/federation (/syndication), and MCP staging all pass the same SSRF guard and immutable raw_text gate.
pipeline.neon.beat1.acc_2: Video 4-step priority: (1) Creator captions -> (2) Auto captions -> (3) STT (gemini-3.5-transcribe) only if no usable caption exists -> (4) Title, description, and chapters cached for 3 days.
pipeline.neon.beat2.title: 02. Dedup · Content Guard · Prompt Budget
pipeline.neon.beat2.api: Checks purged_tombstones, canonical URL updates, SHA-256/MinHash near-duplicates, and validate_extractable_content, then computes prompt budget (preserving tables via table-exemption) and adaptive high effort for research PDFs.
pipeline.neon.beat2.client: After dedup and guard checks, preserves full_content=True without truncation and prepares lock hashes so the agent can acquire claim_token and read nonce-bounded chunks.
pipeline.neon.beat2.output: Verified document record · table-exempt prompt budget · applied_effort
pipeline.neon.beat2.fail: Tombstone blocks (unless force=True), low-quality/blocked pages (insufficient_content), and unsupported --effort values (400) are rejected before extraction.
pipeline.neon.beat2.acc_title: Details: Source table exemption & adaptive reasoning effort rules
pipeline.neon.beat2.acc_1: Table-exemption rule: Even when source text exceeds the character budget, Markdown and AsciiDoc table blocks are preserved first to prevent loss of structured figures.
pipeline.neon.beat2.acc_2: Adaptive paper effort: Research PDFs >= 15,000 chars use high reasoning effort unless overridden by a fixed-effort model suffix or explicit --effort flag.
pipeline.neon.beat3.title: 03. Structured Extraction · AsciiDoc Rendition Rendering
pipeline.neon.beat3.input: Budgeted source text + closed ontology (11 entities · 11 relations) + template rules
pipeline.neon.beat3.api: extract_graph extracts a {lang} summary, key claims, entities, and relations in one call (summarize refines only when assigned a distinct model). In parallel, render_detail compiles the primary standard rendition and optional concise/academic renditions into AOT HTML.
pipeline.neon.beat3.client: Isolated subagent (claire-extractor) reads chunks inside <untrusted_source_document nonce=...> tags and generates summary, rendition, entities, and relations with its own LLM; extract_submit passes 4-layer validation (extra=forbid schema, AsciiDoc, evidence spans, ontology) and precomputes embeddings.
pipeline.neon.beat3.fail: In agent mode, mixed Markdown, spoofed closing tags, hash mismatches, or disallowed model strings fail before DB write. Rendition rendering errors never block graph commit.
pipeline.neon.beat3.acc_title: Details: 3 Rendition templates policy · AED9 4-layer defense
pipeline.neon.beat3.acc_1: 3 Rendition templates: standard (primary · no source tables · representative formulas only), concise (key points · fixed section order · ~1 A4 page), academic (all source tables and formula derivations preserved).
pipeline.neon.beat3.acc_2: Agent isolation (AED9): (1) subagent without shell/write tools, (2) random nonce framing, (3) 4-layer strict schema validation, (4) precomputed embeddings before single-transaction commit.
pipeline.neon.beat4.title: 04. 5-Gate Entity Resolution · Hard Invariants · Relation Check
pipeline.neon.beat4.input: Candidate entity frame (name, type, aliases, up to 5 observations) + KB entities/vectors
pipeline.neon.beat4.api: Gate 1 (exact/alias/3+ char acronym) skips embedding on hit. On miss, 3072d cosine + FTS5 retrieves candidates; Gate 2 checks hard invariants (version v1 vs v2, 2-letter acronyms, type), followed by Gate 3 (>= 0.93 auto-merge) or Gate 4 (0.72-0.93 entity_judge up to 3 candidates), then cross-doc relation_judge and heatmap.
pipeline.neon.beat4.client: extract_submit runs Gate 1 (rules), Gate 2 (hard invariants), Gate 3 (>= 0.93 auto-merge), and Gate 5 (new entity) using precomputed 3072d embeddings before DB write. Gate 4 LLM judge, heatmap, cross-doc relation_judge, and Jev shadow evaluation are skipped.
pipeline.neon.beat4.output: Merged or new entity_id · verified relation edges · resolution_log
pipeline.neon.beat4.fail: Self-loop relations (A -> A) and domain/range mismatches (e.g. authored_by outside Person|Org) are blocked before storage. Neither mode allows low-confidence merges below threshold.
pipeline.neon.beat4.acc_1: Fixed thresholds: sim_tier_auto_merge = 0.93, sim_tier_borderline = 0.72, MAX_JUDGE = 3, relational_candidates >= 0.70.
pipeline.neon.beat4.acc_2: Embedding input scope: only the entity frame (name, type, aliases, up to 5 observations) is embedded into 3072d RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT vectors, never document summaries or body text.
pipeline.neon.beat5.title: 05. SQLite Canonical Commit · Silvercord Publish · Async Follow-ups
pipeline.neon.beat5.input: Document body, rendition HTML, resolved entities/relations, per-stage model_lineage
pipeline.neon.beat5.api: Writes FTS5 full-text indexes (with language-aware tokenizers), 3072d vectors, and model_lineage into kb_id-partitioned claire.db and opens /silvercord/{token}. On new primary ingests in personal KBs (CT10), schedules classify_watch and expand-loop (depth 1, expand_max=0).
pipeline.neon.beat5.client: Commits synchronously in a single _AtomicConnection transaction with origin=agent_client, completing /silvercord/{token} and canonical indexes immediately. classify_watch and expand-loop auto-expansion are not triggered.
pipeline.neon.beat5.output: Canonical record ready for search, graph UI, /silvercord/{token}, MCP, and ActivityPub publication
pipeline.neon.beat5.fail: Raw text (raw_text) and source metadata are immutable (A1), and telemetry is physically separated from canonical claire.db (A4). Shared KBs never run expand, refresh, or recover loops to protect owner billing (CT10).
pipeline.neon.beat5.acc_title: Details: Personal KB 3 worker loops (CT10) · Reprocess guard (before_store)
pipeline.neon.beat5.acc_1: Personal KB worker loops: expand-loop (depth 1 fixed), refresh-loop (re-fetches with same doc.id to preserve entity sources), recover-loop (retries failures preserving original extraction_mode, skipping staged rows).
pipeline.neon.beat5.acc_2: Regeneration guard: during regenerate, existing graph data is preserved until extract_graph succeeds and before_store runs.
